title: Terms & Conditions FOR THE ADMISSION AFFILIATE REFERRAL PROGRAM
kicker: GuideXpert Referral (NIAT) Program · Andhra Pradesh & Telangana · 2026–2027
intro: These Terms & Conditions ("T&Cs") are for the GuideXpert Partner Program (hereinafter referred to as "Partner Program") for the programs/courses (hereinafter referred to as “Program”) offered under  NxtWave of Innovation in Advanced Technologies (“NIAT”) (formerly known as NxtWave Institute of Advanced Technologies) (hereinafter referred to as “NIAT”) initiative by NxtWave Disruptive Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "NxtWave" or "Company"). Please read these T&Cs carefully before participating in the Partner Program. By participating in the Partner Program, you agree to be bound by these T&Cs, which are in addition to and subject to NxtWave’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.

Agreeing to the T&C hereby means that you consent, agree, and undertake to participate in the Partner Program in accordance with the agreed Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of the T&C, please do not participate in the Partner Program.

blocks.text: For the purposes of this T&C, unless there is anything in the subject or context inconsistent therewith, the capitalized terms listed below shall have the following meanings:

items.text: “Affiliate Policies” The policies applicable to affiliates that we may make available to you from time to time.

“Affiliate(s) or Partner(s)” Any individual that has been approved by the Company to promote the Program and is entitled to earn Rewards for successful enrollments. Partners are responsible for marketing and selling the Program to potential Referrals through various channels utilizing their unique Invitation Code or Invitation Link provided by the Company. Partners are expected to accurately and transparently represent the Program, comply with all applicable laws and regulations, and adhere to the Company’s guidelines and ethical standards.
“Bonus”  shall mean any additional amount other than the Reward that is given to the Partner by the Company based on the performance at the sole discretion of the Company.

“Campus Visit Completion or 1-1 Interview”: Refers to the equivalent milestones attained when a Referral has either (i) physically attended the NIAT campus or designated experience center and fulfilled all requisite verification activities, or (ii) successfully participated in a formal one-on-one interview session, as prescribed by the Company on a jurisdictional or state-by-state basis.

“Confidential Information” Any information, whether oral, written, electronic, or in any other form, that is disclosed by the Company to the Partner and is designated as confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential, given the nature of the information and the circumstances of disclosure. Confidential Information includes, but is not limited to, all non-public information relating to the Company's business, products, services, research and development, technology, software, trade secrets, know-how, business plans, strategies, forecasts, customer and supplier information, financial data, pricing, marketing plans, and any other information that is identified as confidential or proprietary. Confidential Information also includes all copies, summaries, notes, analyses, and other derivatives of such information.

“Enrollment”  The process by which a Referral completes all necessary steps and requirements to register for the Program. Enrollment is achieved when the Referral makes the first-term payment of the Program as determined by the Company. Enrollment is considered complete only when all financial transactions are successfully processed, any required documentation is signed and/or submitted, and the Referral is officially registered in the Company’s system for the Program.
“Partner” shall mean any individual who is onboarded as a GuideXpert by the Company and completes the GuideXpert Test and Onboarding Form.
“Program Fee”  shall mean the fee charged by the Company for the Program. The Program fee may vary across campuses.

“Invitation Code” A unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to each Partner by the Company. This code is used to track and credit the Partner for successful Referrals who enroll in the Program. The Invitation Code must be entered by the Referral during the registration or payment process to ensure the Partner receives the appropriate Reward and bonuses.

“Invitation Link(s)” The customized weblink(s) provided to each Partner containing their unique Invitation Code embedded within the URL. These links are designed for easy sharing and can be used by Referrals to register for or make payments towards the Program. When a Referral uses an Invitation Link, the Partner’s unique code is automatically recorded, ensuring that the Partner is credited for the Referral’s enrollment.

“Milestone 1”: Refers to the successful transition of a Referral from the Campus Visit (CV) / 1-1 Interview stage to the completion of SR. This milestone is achieved only when a Referral, having completed the CV/Interview, remits the SR Fee and completes all reservation formalities within the applicable Window Period.

“Milestone 2”: Refers to the successful transition of a Referral from the SR stage to Enrollment. This milestone is achieved only when a Referral, having successfully completed Milestone 1, remits the full first-term Program Fee and submits all mandatory documentation.

“NAT Form” Refers to the NxtWave Aptitude Test application, inclusive of campus visit scheduling module. Submission of this form serves as the official mechanism by which a Referral applies for Program admission and formally requests the coordination of an on site visit.
“Qualified Lead or QL” Refers to a prospective lead who has duly appeared for and completed the NxtWave Aptitude Test (NAT) or any other entrance examination prescribed by the Company.

“Referral” means an individual introduced to the Program by a Partner who is recognized as a valid lead for Reward eligibility. An individual shall be classified as a “Valid Referral” only if they fulfill the specific next-action requirement corresponding to their current stage in the admission lifecycle, strictly utilizing the Partner’s unique Invitation Link or Invitation Code as follows:
children: Pre-NAT Payment: If the individual has not yet remitted the NAT Fee, they must complete the NAT Fee payment specifically through the Partner’s unique link.

Post-NAT / Pre-Interview: If the individual has already remitted the NAT Fee but has not yet completed a Campus Visit or 1-1 Online Interview, they must successfully attend the Campus Visit or 1-1 Online Interview facilitated under the Partner’s attribution.

Post-Interview / Pre-SR: If the individual has already completed the Campus Visit or 1-1 Online Interview but has not yet reserved a seat, they must complete the Seat Reservation (SR) payment specifically through the Partner’s unique link.Notwithstanding the completion of the actions above, a Referral is deemed "Valid" only if the transition between stages is completed within the strictly enforced Window Periods defined below. Any action performed outside these timelines, or through organic channels/alternate links, shall result in the automatic lapse of Partner attribution, and the individual shall no longer be considered a Valid Referral for the purposes of Reward 1 or Reward 2.

items.text: “Reward 1”: The monetary compensation earned by a Partner for each successful Seat Reservation (SR) of a Referral into the Program. The amount of the reward is INR 4000/- and is subject the conditions mentioned below.

“Reward 2”: The monetary compensation earned by a Partner for each successful Enrollment of a Referral into the Program. The amount of the reward is determined and is subject the conditions mentioned below.

“Seat Reservation or SR” Refers to the act by which a Referral confirms their intent to enroll by completing the prescribed reservation formalities and, where applicable, remitting the requisite portion of the Seat Reservation Fee. This act signifies the transition from a prospective lead to a reserved candidate within the Company’s systems.

“Seat Reservation Fee” The initial non-refundable fee payable by a Referral at the time of enrollment to reserve their seat in the Program. Payment of the Seat Reservation Fee is a prerequisite for further processing of enrollment and securing participation in the Program.

“Window Periods”: Refers to the strictly enforced time-bound intervals within which a Referral must progress between milestones to qualify for Partner Rewards. The Window Periods are defined as follows:

To be eligible to join the Partner Program, you must agree to the Partner Program Terms and Conditions. In the application, you are required to provide your full name and any other requested information. Upon signing up for the Program, we will review your application. We reserve the right at our sole discretion to reject your application or re-evaluate it at any point in time.

You are permitted to create and use only one Affiliate account. You will receive a confirmation of your participation once your application is approved. Upon approval, you may have direct access to your affiliate dashboard, a unique Invitation Code, and an Invitation Link.

The Partner’s primary role is to act as a promoter for the Company, introducing potential Referrals to the Program. You are to use your Invitation Code and Invitation Link to refer potential participants to the Program.

As a Partner in the Partner Program, you are authorized to market and promote the Program. To assist you, marketing materials such as banners, brochures, posters, digital assets and guidebooks will be provided through your dashboard or E-mail or WhatsApp or any other medium deemed appropriate by the Company.

The Partner bears the sole responsibility for ensuring that all promotional information is kept up to date. For example, if there are changes in pricing, packages, or services at NxtWave, it is the Partner’s sole responsibility to update the information accordingly.

Partners must be onboarded through an authorized Company representative. Partners must complete the onboarding form and accept these terms. Partners must be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering into binding agreements.

A Referral shall be deemed valid only if the individual has registered through the Partner’s unique Invitation Link and/or Invitation Code and has followed the prescribed process set forth in these Terms and Conditions.

The ownership and validity of a Referral shall be subject to the following conditions and timeframes, and failure to comply with any of the below stages shall result in the forfeiture of ownership by the Partner:
children: NAT Fee to QL: The Referral must transition from the initial payment of the NAT Fee to QL status within the prescribed Window Period.
QL to Campus Visit/Interview: The Referral must complete the Campus Visit or 1-1 Interview within the period defined in the Window Periods table.
Visit/Interview to Seat Reservation (SR): Following the successful completion of the Campus Visit or Interview, the Referral must complete SR within the period defined in the Window Periods.

items.text: Upon the expiration of any applicable Window Period without the successful achievement of the next milestone, the Partner’s ownership of the Referral shall lapse automatically, rendering the Referral "Open Market" and eligible for acquisition by the Company or any other Partner; provided, however, that while the original Partner may re-establish ownership by securing the next milestone via their unique link, such ownership is not protected and shall be re-attributed to any other Partner who first initiates a new engagement and triggers a successful milestone completion via their respective Invitation Link, in which case the original Partner shall have no claim to any associated Rewards. Notwithstanding the above, only upon the discretion of the Company, if a lead remains in the "Open Market" and has not been acquired by another Partner, the original Partner may re-establish ownership. Ownership is deemed restored only if the original Partner secures the successful completion of the next pending milestone through their unique Invitation Link/Code before any other party.

A Partner shall retain ownership of a Referral only if the Referral adheres to all the aforementioned conditions within the stipulated Window Periods. Any failure to meet the prescribed requirements shall result in the automatic loss of Referral ownership, and the Partner shall no longer be eligible for any associated Rewards.

The Company’s backend tracking system shall serve as the sole and final arbiter for determining which Partner successfully "tapped" or restored the lead. The Partner who triggers the milestone completion first in the system shall be recognized as the exclusive owner.

If a Referral visits an NIAT campus prior to registering through the Partner’s unique Invitation Link or Invitation Code, the Partner shall have no claim to the Referral and shall not be entitled to any Rewards in respect of such Referral’s enrollment. However, if the Referral enrolls through the Partner’s link after a period of 30 days from the date of the campus visit, this restriction shall no longer apply.

In instances where multiple Referrers claim ownership over the same Referral, the Company shall have the exclusive authority to determine the final ownership of the Referral. The Company’s decision in this regard shall be final, binding, and not subject to dispute.

All Referrals are strictly required to maintain a single, consistent mobile number as their Primary Unique Identifier throughout the entire NIAT admission lifecycle; accordingly, the submission of multiple contact numbers for a single Referral is prohibited and shall constitute a material breach of lead integrity, resulting in the automatic disqualification of said Referral for Reward purposes. In the event of data conflicts, duplications, or identity ambiguities arising from the use of multiple identifiers, the Company reserves the exclusive and absolute prerogative to render a final, non-appealable determination regarding Reward eligibility and ownership attribution, and the Partner hereby waives any claim to Rewards for leads that fail to maintain this unique identifier consistency.

Only digital form submissions completed through the Partner’s unique Invitation Link shall be deemed valid for Referral ownership and Reward eligibility. Any Referral communicated through verbal confirmation, WhatsApp, email, or any other unofficial means shall not be recognized for the purposes of Referral ownership.

Mere registration for a Webinar, filling of the Application Form, or Campus Visit Form shall not, in itself, qualify a Referral for ownership or Reward entitlement. The Webinar shall be treated solely as an educational and nurturing resource for prospective students and parents and shall not establish Referral ownership in favor of a Partner.

These Terms and Conditions do not create an exclusive agreement between the Partner and the Company. The Company retains the right to engage other Partners to promote, sell, and support their products and services.

However, the Partner agrees not to engage directly or indirectly with any other company or entity that offers products or services similar to those of NxtWave during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months following the termination of this Agreement. The Partner shall not provide any services or support to any competitors of the Company that would conflict with the interests of the Company.

The relationship between the Company and the Partner is that of independent contractors. Nothing in these T&Cs shall be construed to create a partnership, joint venture, or employer-employee relationship between the parties.

Reward 1: For every Referral who successfully achieves SR within the prescribed Window Periods, the Partner shall be entitled to a fixed reward of ₹4,000/- (Four Thousand Indian Rupees). This amount serves as a performance-linked incentive for securing a committed lead.

Reward 2 (Final Enrollment Slab Reward): Upon the successful compilation of the conditions defined under Milestone 2, ie, the Referral has successfully completed Milestone 1, remits the full first-term Program Fee and submits all mandatory documentation the Partner shall become eligible for the Milestone 2 Reward. The final payout per enrollment shall be determined by the following tiered structure:

blocks.text: Per Enrollment - Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only)

items.text: Milestone 1 (SR) Reward: 2 x 4,000 = ₹8,000/- (Paid upon Seat Reservation)
Milestone 2 (Slab 1) Reward: 2 x 16,000 = ₹32,000/-

blocks.text: **The payout slab shall be determined based on the total number of successful enrollments achieved by the Partner during the applicable cycle. Once a Partner qualifies for a higher slab, the corresponding payout rate shall apply to all enrollments achieved by the Partner in that cycle.
The Rewards shall be disbursed in two tranches in the following manner:

items.text: Reward 1: ₹4,000 can be redeemed after seven (7) days from the date of the SR  payment by the Referral.

Reward 2: The remaining payout may be redeemed no earlier than ninety (90) days and no later than one hundred fifty (150) days following the Referral’s commencement of Term-1 classes, provided that all conditions set forth in these Terms and Conditions are met.

blocks.text: In cases where a Referral has successfully completed Milestone 1 (and the associated ₹4,000/- has been earned/disbursed) but the term-1 fee remains unpaid beyond the Company’s deadline, the Partner shall not be entitled to the Milestone 2 (Enrollment) Reward. For the avoidance of doubt, the Milestone 1 payment shall be retained by the Partner for the services rendered in securing the reservation; however, in the event the Referral receives a refund of the SR due to any reasons whatsoever or if the Seat Reservation was secured through the use of false commitments, misrepresentation, or any breach of the Code of Conduct by the Partner, the Company reserves the right to recover Milestone 1 Rewards by deducting or offsetting the equivalent amount from the Partner’s future Reward payouts or any outstanding balances. A Reward 1 is only deemed "final" upon the Referral’s successful transition to Milestone 2 (Enrollment) without a refund of the SR.
The Partner shall not be eligible for Rewards under the following circumstances:

items.text: If the Referral is granted a fee concession, scholarship, or waiver of any portion of the Admission or Program Fee.
If the Referral enrolls in/transfers to any other NxtWave product that is not part of the Program.
The amount of the Reward to be paid will be subject to applicable statutory deductions such as Tax Deducted at Source (“TDS”).
The Reward and other benefits are inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, and levies.

For clarity, the Reward shall not be granted to the Partner for enrollments made through any other Partner’s Invitation Link or Invitation Code. In case of any disputes, the decision of the Company shall be final and binding.

Reward 1 and Reward 2 shall not be paid if the Referral claims a refund before the disbursal of either of the Rewards. If the Referral claims a refund post the payment of the Rewards, then the Rewards paid to the Partner shall be recovered or deducted/adjusted in future Rewards payable to the Partner.

If the Company receives multiple refund requests from Referrals of a particular Partner and suspects misuse of the Partner Program or Program by either the Referrals or the Partner, the Company may withhold any pending payments to the Partner. Additionally, any Reward already paid to the Partner shall be recovered or deducted/adjusted from future Rewards payable to the Partner.

If the Company receives more than three consecutive refund requests or more than three refund requests within a month from Referrals of a particular Partner and/or suspects misuse of the Partner Program or Program by either the Referrals or the Partner, the Company may at its sole discretion immediately suspend the Partner’s participation in the Partner Program. Additionally, the Company may withhold any pending payments to the Partner. Any Reward already paid to the Partner shall be recovered or deducted/adjusted from future Rewards payable to the Partner.

If the Partner does not raise the invoice within 120 days from the date of notifying the Partner about their eligibility to claim the Reward with respect to a Referral, the Partner shall forfeit the right to claim and/or receive the unclaimed Reward for that Referral.

The Reward structure and amounts mentioned above are for indicative purposes only. The Company reserves the right to modify the terms of the Reward, including its structure and amounts, at its sole discretion and on a Partner-by-Partner basis.
The Partner will not receive any additional Reward if their Referral, who is an existing customer of a Program, upgrades or changes to any other Program in the future.
